name: Mecca
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid. The ministry’s citywide service description and Makkah-specific registration announcements establish local parcel mapping/registration activity but not queryable geometry at this exact point. The local explorer presented a login prompt; no login was attempted. Official public ArcGIS directories inspected for the municipality contained basemap/street/neighborhood layers, not parcel polygons. No full parcel geometry or owner/address data retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Municipalities and Housing describes its public U Maps urban-map service as covering Saudi cities and displaying roads, land plots and services. Makkah Municipality also operates a city geospatial explorer, and official Real Estate Registry announcements document initial parcel registration in portions of Makkah neighborhoods. None of the sources establishes that the exact WUP point is within a registered block, and no public parcel layer endpoint was exposed.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry of Municipalities and Housing U Maps service page describes a free public urban-map service for Saudi cities showing roads, land plots and services; service page did not expose a queryable layer endpoint.
Official Arabic service description for the same urban-map product.
Makkah Municipality geospatial explorer; the public app showed a login modal, and no login was submitted or service query made.
Official local map service lists roads, neighborhoods, holy mosque and municipal boundaries; no parcel layer was present in the inspected service.
Official municipal basemap service lists landmarks, blocks, neighborhoods and road centerlines; no cadastral parcel layer was present.
Saudi Press Agency official release documents initial real-property registration in ten Makkah neighborhoods; it does not establish coverage of the ranked point.
Saudi Press Agency official release identifies registration in portions of several Makkah neighborhoods; the notice does not spatially bind the WUP point.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: The ministry landing page describes the U Maps product and links into Balady; the linked product did not yield an inspectable public service config in this run. The local Makkah explorer required login. Public municipal ArcGIS service listings inspected were basemaps and transportation/administrative layers only, not cadastral plots.
